description: Sign the user up for an email reminder before a public event that search_events returned, or for an email when a value beep.me reads crosses a line the user chose (a watch from search_events). Ask the user for their email address first (never guess it) and pass either the event id, or the watch's source with direction and value. A new address gets one confirmation email, and the reminder is switched on once the user clicks the link in it. Only for events and watches search_events returned, never for personal appointments. When beep.me is connected with sign-in, leave email out: it is on at once, with no confirmation email.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code of the user.

direction.description: With source: 'over' emails when the value is at or above value, 'under' at or below. Default: the watch's suggested direction.

email.description: The user's own email address, exactly as they gave it. Leave it out when beep.me is connected with sign-in: the signed-in account's own address is used.

event_id.description: The id of an event search_events returned. Leave it out for a watch.

every.description: With source: true emails every time the value crosses the line again, false once. Default: the watch's suggestion.

language.description: Language for the emails: 'no' for Norwegian, 'en' for English (default).

remind_before_minutes.description: Optional. How many minutes before the start the email should arrive, when the user said so: 30 for «half an hour before», 1440 for «a day before». Leave it out to use the event's own time.

source.description: A watch's source from search_events ('pollen/oslo-bjork'), for an email when its value crosses a line. With source, pass direction and value too.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone of the user, e.g. 'Europe/Oslo', so the email shows their local time.

value.description: With source: the line, in the watch's unit (18 for 18 °C, 3 for pollen level 3). Default: the watch's suggested value.

name: remind_me
title: Email me a reminder
